summary: Farmers around the world are facing changes in temperatures, variations in rainfall patterns, water scarcity, extreme weather events, and deterioration of soil health; therefore, we plan to develop START_3, an intelligent platform that will integrate NASA data, meteorological information, and data obtained directly from farms to identify risk conditions and anticipate potential agricultural problems.
details:
Farmers around the world are facing changing temperatures, so we thought of developing START_3, an intelligent platform that will integrate NASA data, meteorological information, and data obtained directly from farms to identify risk conditions and anticipate potential agricultural problems.

Gemini will be used as a support tool to:

  • Research information related to agriculture and artificial intelligence.
  • Understand and analyze datasets.
  • Support code generation and review.
  • Propose machine learning models.
  • Resolve questions during technological development.

Gemini will serve as an assistance tool and will not replace the scientific validation of the results.

Notepad will be used to:

  • Create and edit text files.
  • Write HTML code.
  • Save configuration files.
  • Organize code snippets and project documentation.

Python will be one of the main languages of the project, used to:

  • Download and process satellite data.
  • Clean and organize databases.
  • Perform statistical analysis.
  • Train artificial intelligence models.
  • Generate agricultural risk predictions.
  • Create graphs and analytical results.

Libraries such as Pandas, NumPy, Scikit-learn, Matplotlib, and GeoPandas may be used.
